jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description: HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world’s leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We’re at €85M revenue and we’re aiming to 10x that in the next decade. Every hire we make needs to help get us there. This is not a role where you take orders and pass on CVs. HelloPrint is reinventing itself, and every hire decides how fast that happens. You lead recruitment: you find out what the team really needs, source the people, sell them on HelloPrint and close the deal, using AI to reach more people, faster. You report to Hans (CEO) and Lizzy (VP People & Organization) and work independently with Hiring Managers. What you’ll do: Lead recruitment end to end and independently, from intake to signed offer, for tech, e-commerce, growth, marketing and staff roles. Work closely with hiring managers and ask the critical questions: do we need this role, what does the team actually need, and what does success look like? Bring organization design into the process: role scope, team setup and how a hire fits the bigger picture. Steer the process and the decisions. You set the pace and push for answers. Source first. You find candidates yourself on LinkedIn, in communities and through your network. Agencies are a supplement, not the plan. Sell HelloPrint, screen and guide candidates, and close the deal. Nobody is left waiting without an answer. Build and improve AI workflows for sourcing, outreach and screening, on top of our existing AI screening. Grow our employer brand through events and connections, and report on pipeline and results so everyone sees where hiring stands. What makes this role hard: you work independently, you challenge hiring managers who just want the role filled, and the range of profiles runs from engineers to marketers to staff. What we’re looking for: Must-haves: A few years of hand

jobs.title: Junior HR Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Eine Pflegekraft aus Indien landet in Deutschland, und alles ist geregelt: Visum, Wohnung, Anmeldung, erster Arbeitstag. Dafür sorgst Du. Die WTE Group baut Unternehmen gegen den Fachkräftemangel. Mit WTE Charkos bringen wir Pflege- und Kita-Fachkräfte aus Indien nach Deutschland, mit B2-Deutsch vor dem ersten Gespräch und eigenem Ausbildungszentrum in Mysore. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Universitätskliniken, und jede Vermittlung besetzt eine Stelle in Pflege oder Kita und bedeutet einen Neustart für einen Menschen. Was Du machst Du begleitest internationale Fachkräfte von der Zusage bis zum ersten Arbeitstag. Du stellst Unterlagen für Anerkennung und Visum zusammen und prüfst sie. Du koordinierst Termine mit Behörden, Arbeitgebern und Unterkünften. Du bist Ansprechperson für Kliniken, Pflegeheime und unser Team in Indien. Du organisierst das Onboarding vor Ort und setzt klare Prozesse um, mit KI (Claude) als Werkzeug. Was Du mitbringst Ein abgeschlossenes Studium. Die Fachrichtung ist offen, Berufserfahrung brauchst Du nicht. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig. Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Lust, mit KI zu arbeiten. Was wir bieten 36.000 bis 45.000 € brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Kenntnissen. Neues Büro in Hamburg, kleines Team und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den beiden Gründern. Früh eigene Verantwortung und gründliche Einarbeitung, damit Du nach kurzer Zeit eigene Fälle sicher betreust. KI-gestütztes Arbeiten mit Claude ab Tag 1. Teams in Hamburg und Indien, bei denen Du viel über internationale Zusammenarbeit lernst. Bewirb Dich in 2 Minuten mit Deinem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht. jobs.title: Kepala Divisi HR Recruitment & Training
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan : Memimpin dan mengelola Divisi Recruitment serta Training & Development untuk memastikan kualitas layanan dan pencapaian target pemenuhan perusahaan. Mengembangkan strategi recruitment, mulai dari manpower planning, sourcing, selection, hingga pemenuhan kebutuhan tenaga kerja. Mengembangkan program Training & Development berdasarkan kebutuhan perusahaan maupun klien, termasuk Training Needs Analysis (TNA) dan evaluasi efektivitas training. Membangun, menjaga, dan mengembangkan hubungan kerja sama dengan klien existing maupun calon klien. Melakukan meeting, presentasi, negosiasi, serta mengidentifikasi kebutuhan klien terkait layanan Recruitment dan Training. Mengawasi kinerja tim, pencapaian KPI, kualitas layanan, serta efektivitas operasional divisi. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal S1 Psikologi, Manajemen SDM, Manajemen, atau bidang relevan lainnya. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2-3 tahun di bidang HR, khususnya Recruitment dan Training & Development. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun dalam memimpin tim atau sebagai Team Leader/Kepala Divisi/SPV dsb. Memahami proses end-to-end Recruitment, Manpower Planning, Training Needs Analysis (TNA), dan Learning & Development. Memiliki pengalaman berhubungan langsung dengan klien, melakukan presentasi, negosiasi, serta membangun kerja sama bisnis. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi, interpersonal, dan problem solving yang baik. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office, khususnya Excel dan PowerPoint. Pengalaman di perusahaan Recruitment Agency, Outsourcing, HR Consulting, Manpower Services, atau Training Provider menjadi nilai tambah. Bersedia melakukan kunjungan atau perjalanan dinas ke klien apabila diperlukan.

jobs.title: Contracts Manager Federal
jobs.description:
$100,000 - $120,000 a year Akicita Federal, LLC is a growing 8(a) small business that delivers healthcare, professional, and administrative services to federal agencies. We're adding a contracts manager to help us grow beyond our current work. The job is to find opportunities, write winning proposals quickly, and build lasting relationships with agencies and teaming partners. What you'll do Find and respond to federal opportunities, focusing on small business and 8(a) set-asides Write, assemble, and submit proposals at high volume, often turning one around in a day or two Manage contracts after award: point of contact for agencies, modifications, compliance, and reporting Spend about a quarter of your time on teaming and partnership outreach to other small businesses Work with our recruiting team to staff new awards Use AI tools to work faster. We expect speed and don't want proposals built by hand from scratch. What you bring 3+ years in federal contracting: contracts management, proposal writing, capture, or program management Solid understanding of the FAR, set-aside programs, and the federal procurement process An existing network of agency or contractor relationships is a strong plus You're comfortable with AI tools, or eager to become a power user You'd rather submit ten good proposals than polish one forever
